## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:core`
- [ ] `npm run budget`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Tested in Chrome / Brave / Arc / Edge
- [ ] Tested in Firefox / Zen
- [ ] Tested at 360px, 768px, 1440px, and 2560px widths
- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation checked
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` checked

## Screenshots or recording

<!-- Before/after images are required for visible UI changes. -->

## Privacy and security checklist

- [ ] No new network request without a documented destination, default state, off switch, and user-visible explanation.
- [ ] No analytics, telemetry, remote fonts, or remote scripts.
- [ ] No inline scripts or CSP relaxation.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal paths, or backup files committed.
- [ ] Imported or external data is validated before it reaches storage or the DOM.
- [ ] The gzipped JS + CSS bundle remains under the current budget.
